decisions.why: the division's 60 captured products are upper/lower extremity and spine implants (Cervical Cage, KONG-C/TL VBR System, VADER Pedicle System, Anterior Cervical Plate, STAR Ankle, ELiS CMCJ Replacement, Spaceflex Shoulder, EXABONE bone graft substitutes = ortho:implant); trauma/fixation hardware for hand, wrist, elbow, forearm and clavicle (Dorsal Hook Plate, Volar Fixed Angle Plate, Forearm Plates, Olecranon Hook Plate/Sled, Radial Column plates, Clavicle plates, Wrist Fusion Plate, K-wires, screws, staples = ortho:trauma); and surgical instruments (Percutaneous Burrs, Surgical Burs, Saw blades = ortho:equip). Awarded on Total Orthopaedic Solutions 3. This division replaced the stale 'Categories'/'Brands' split (both now unmapped orphans in the map, superseded by this crawl) after scripts/union_differentiator_pairs.py --apply added the new pair on 17/09/2026.
